name: Atoll
design_intent:
ATOLL — the radial-ring level (v1_level_circuit.md §L-9, build order #4). A coral-atoll / crater rim: a RING of six platforms encircling a central void WELL, arranged in an oval that wraps AROUND an open central column. Kill identity = knock rivals INWARD into the central well (the shared maw all rim platforms overlook) OR OUTWARD off the ring's outer edges -> off the screen. Kill-shape class = void_is_floor -> QA uses K1' (off-screen kills >= 88%, uncredited self-falls <= 12%) per docs/specs/v2a_kill_shape_void_floor_addendum.md §3. NOTE ON CLASS (v1_circuit §2 lists 'central_pit + ring'): the central_pit K1 target (edges>=60%/pit<=30%) is for a DEMOTED mid-map hole in a solid floor (grassy_expanse), where the pit is a minority hazard. Atoll's well is the PRIMARY killer (there is no solid floor — the ring platforms float over the void), so per the addendum §2-3 the void-floor target (off-screen>=88%) applies, NOT central_pit's ratio; a high central/void share is the fantasy working. The per-level RADIAL shape check AT1 (deaths split BOTH into the central well AND off the outer rim) is measured from kills[].vx: a void death with |vx| < ~700 fell through the central column (the WELL); a left/right side-blast or a void death with |vx| > ~1300 rang out off the OUTER RIM. Neither < 20% of void deaths -> proves the radial in/out shape, not a single de-facto pit.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT FROM the five prior shipped levels: islands_void is a LINEAR archipelago (four islands left-to-right over one bottom void); the_spine is ONE thin linear ridge; twin_chasms is a LINEAR two-void split; the_cliff is a LINEAR asymmetric mesa+scatter; drop_chamber is an enclosed bumper drum. Atoll is the only RADIAL layout — six platforms wrap in an OVAL RING (two low shelves flanking the well at the base, two mid shelves out at the sides, two spring perches up top flanking the well mouth, plus a central spring throne hovering over the well). Combat WRAPS around the rim (up one side, across the top, down the other) instead of running along a line, and every rim platform overlooks the same central maw -> a super fired ACROSS the well is a dramatic diameter-spanning play. Feel = 'fight around the crater; knock them into the middle or off the rim.'

ENGINE RISK: NONE new. Reuses the islands-over-void static-geometry physics + the pit_void_rendering void treatment. The two LOWEST platforms (the bottom shelves BL/BR) are the only floor-band islands, so _paint_void_gaps carves the gap BETWEEN them (the well mouth, x-320..320) into a dark canyon maw with hazard-red rim + chevrons descending from the shelf line -> the central well reads as a lethal maw. The four higher ring platforms (mid shelves + top perches) float in open sky OVER the void (above the FLOOR_BAND), exactly like islands_void's elevated thrones. No new primitive; no Tuning/lethality/feel constant touched (fence per v1_level_circuit.md §6 — GEOMETRY + theme only).

GEOMETRY (centred on x=0 for radial symmetry): BL bottom-left shelf (trampoline, x-1400..-320, top y1120, h128) / BR bottom-right shelf (trampoline, x320..1400, top y1120, h128) flank the CENTRAL WELL (the gap x-320..320 = 640px, open to the bottom void). ML mid-left shelf (bubblegum, x-1900..-1300, top y600, h112) / MR mid-right (bubblegum, x1300..1900, top y600, h112) sit OUT at the sides, 520px above the base. TL top-left perch (spring, x-1000..-320, top y200, h48) / TR top-right perch (spring, x320..1000, top y200, h48) flank the well mouth up top. CENTRAL THRONE (spring, x-180..180, top y-360, h48) hovers 560px ABOVE the top perches, dead-centre over the well (the contested apex prize; falling off it drops straight down the central column into the maw). ONE full-width lethal void band (rim y1260, dark bottomless chasm) runs under the whole span; the carved BL<->BR gap is the central WELL maw. Bounds -2500..2500 keep the mid shelves' outer edges (x-1900) only ~600px inside the side blast lines (the OUTER RIM — a knock outward off ML/MR is a fast side ring-out), and the bottom bound y1920 leaves 672px of recovery sky under the base shelves (2232px under the throne — the deep well). Top bound -3010 = throne top (-360) minus the 2650 clearance so a straight-up self-super arcs back (no routine top self-destruct).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270px / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; air_drift_max 340px/s, gravity 1600 => zero-boost horizontal reach ~395px off a trampoline, ~320px off bubblegum, ~527px off a spring; normal_boost_max 760px/s crosses a 580-800px gap in <1s @ ~26 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super_boost_impulse 2800 clears everything but dumps the tank). Traversal WRAPS around the ring; every neighbour-to-neighbour move is flight-required (horizontal gap > 527, OR vertical climb > 480 apex):
- BOTTOM crossing BL<->BR over the WELL: BL right edge x-320 -> BR left edge x320 = 640px of open void (the well mouth). > 527 max spring drift and >> 395 trampoline drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED (a committed boost across the maw); miss = fall INTO the well (central death). Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- LEFT climb BL->ML: BL top y1120 -> ML top y600 = 520px vertical climb (ML sits directly up-and-outboard, x-overlapping). Trampoline apex 270 from BL reaches only y850 -> 250px short of ML. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; an under-shot drops off BL's outer side. Verb: FLY. (Rule B, >= 500.)
- UPPER-LEFT ML->TL: ML (x-1900..-1300, top600) -> TL (x-1000..-400, top200) = 300px horizontal gap AND 400px vertical up (diagonal ~500px). Bubblegum apex 180 from ML reaches only y420 -> 220px below TL and 300px short horizontally; neither a bounce nor drift covers the diagonal. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED (a boosted arc). Verb: FLY.
- TOP crossing TL<->TR over the WELL: TL right edge x-320 -> TR left edge x320 = 640px over the well mouth (the top of the column). > 527. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall down the central column into the maw. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- (the RIGHT side BR->MR->TR mirrors the left exactly.)
- CLIMB to the CENTRAL THRONE (top y-360): 560px above the top perches (TL/TR at y200). A spring bounce off TL (apex 480) reaches only y-280 -> 80px short, and the throne hangs over the OPEN well so an under-shot drops straight down the central column into the maw. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED (a spring-launched boost, or a SUPER for the diameter-spanning contest). Verb: FLY. (Rule B, >= 500.)
- SUPER as the committed cross-map play: a full super fires ACROSS the well (rim-to-rim diameter, ~2800px corner-to-corner) or up to the throne in one blast (snipe a rival off the far rim into the well) but drains the tank -> the committed play, not routine traversal. Verb: FLY+SMASH. (Rule C.)
- RECOVER: a fall INTO the well (off a shelf/perch/throne) drops from the surface bottom (base 1248 / mid 712 / perch 248 / throne -312) down the central column to the bottom blast line (y1920) = 672px (base) up to 2232px (throne) of open sky -> a healthy fuelled player boosts back UP out of the well mouth (the recovery gamble), while a near-brink dead-on down-smash spikes them past the rim. A knock OUTWARD off ML/MR (only ~600px inside the side blast) is a shorter, less-recoverable OUTER-RIM ring-out. Verb: FLY. (Rule D.)
- No bounce route exists around the ring or up to the throne (every hop > 527 horizontal or > 480 vertical apex), so the jetpack is required to move at all. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.

SUCCESS CRITERIA (void_is_floor class + per-level radial checks, §L-9): AT1 — >= 12 stages: credited off-screen kills >= 90%; deaths occur BOTH into the central WELL (void, |vx| < ~700) AND off the OUTER RIM (side blasts + void |vx| > ~1300), neither < 20% of void deaths -> proves the radial in/out shape. AT2 — flight-required: rim-to-rim gaps and the throne climb need a boost >= 9/10 (zero-boost falls into the well or off the rim). AT3 — the central well reads as a lethal maw (screenshots): a naive viewer names 'knock them into the middle' as a goal. VOID READS AS DEATH via the pit_void_rendering treatment (dark cool bottomless gradient + receding dirt canyon walls at the BL/BR shelf cliffs + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons along the well mouth + falling motes) so the central well is unmistakably lethal, not safe green.
